title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
An AI image generation system was used to create nonconsensual sexual imagery of a real person. The person obtained photographs from the victim's private social media accounts and used AI to generate explicit morphed images, then distributed them across multiple platforms through anonymous accounts to conceal his identity. The deployment failure is the absence of any system preventing the use of AI tools for this purpose, and the absence of detection by the platforms where the content was shared.

What would have caught this is either technical barriers in the AI system itself to reject requests for generating explicit sexual imagery of real people, or detection systems operated by the social platforms to identify and remove nonconsensual intimate images. The victim discovered the abuse only when messengers alerted her to its circulation.

It is not established what safeguards, if any, the AI image generation system contained, or whether the platforms' detection systems failed to identify the content or the accounts distributing it.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and sharing obscene AI-generated images of a college acquaintance. Bansal obtained photographs from the woman's private social media account and used artificial intelligence technology to create explicit morphed images. He then distributed this content through multiple fake accounts on Instagram, Discord, and Facebook while using various Gmail addresses to hide his identity.

The victim discovered the abuse when she received messages from anonymous Instagram accounts informing her that her altered photographs and videos were circulating on Discord servers. She filed a complaint with the Cyber Police Station in North Delhi. Investigators analyzed digital footprints and traced the fake accounts back to Bansal. During questioning, he revealed he knew the woman from college and had developed personal resentment toward her following repeated conflicts. Police recovered his mobile phone, SIM cards, and other digital evidence, with investigation ongoing.
